titolo: RuyiJS launches lightweight headless Firefox engine for AI-driven web automation
descr: The open‑source ruyijs library offers a minimal Firefox‑based browser without a UI, targeting AI agents for scraping and reverse‑engineering tasks.
paragrafi: The GitHub project cutetailbud/ff-ruyijs provides a headless browser built on Firefox 159 internals, aimed at AI agents like Codex or Claude Code.
It embeds the SpiderMonkey JavaScript engine and Necko networking stack, omitting windows, rendering and GPU components to stay lightweight.
Pre‑built wheels are available for Windows x64, macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64 on PyPI, requiring Python 3.10+ and specific system libraries such as glibc 2.39 on Linux.
Each browser context runs in its own process with isolated JavaScript state and optional proxy support, allowing reproducible sessions and offline script execution.
The project is released under AGPL‑3.0; commercial or proprietary use needs a separate license, and the maintainers stress that brute‑force reverse engineering is prohibited.
perche: For developers building AI agents, ruyijs offers a fast, low‑resource way to execute real Firefox JavaScript, improving success against anti‑bot measures. It also provides a free, open‑source option for local automation, complementing the growing ecosystem of free chat models such as Kimi K3 and GLM‑5.3.
